item.text:
According to the **ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide**, under Geometry Stories (p. 54, Table 11):

- **49%** of housing units are in one-story buildings.
- The data source is **U.S. EIA’s 2009 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **Basements are excluded**. Stories count floors above grade; finished attics are included.

[Source: Technical Reference Guide, p. 54](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=55)

There is a documentation discrepancy: the [release’s online characteristics page](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/2025_release_1/workflow_inputs/characteristics.html#geometry-stories) lists **53%**, while the release-specific technical guide lists **49%**.
